Leggi il documento e restituisci i tre codici INIZIO, CENTRO e FINE. INIZIO: AMBRA-4729

Project Maya

GLM-5.3-Flash (321 B), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (748 B) and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (428 B) on your own GPU
private and fast · one NVIDIA GPU or up to 16 · AMD and Windows (experimental) · chat, pictures, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API · several requests at once

Created and led by Peasant Smith (@mw00), co-maintained with @needmorevram


Project Maya is free. If it runs well on your PC, sponsoring it pays for the test hardware and the work on it.

Models this size usually need a datacenter. Maya runs three of them on the hardware you already have: **GLM-5.3-Flash**, **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** and **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash**. Each model has an engine built for it. It keeps the experts your conversation uses most on the GPU, the next ones in RAM and the rest on your NVMe SSD, and moves them as you chat. It measures your GPUs, CPU, RAM and SSD and tunes itself to them. Nothing leaves your machine. - **Fast:** up to 149 tokens/s on two RTX 5090s and an RTX 4090, 124 on two H100s, 118 on four RTX 4090s, 81 on one RTX PRO 6000, 30+ on a single RTX 5090. [Real numbers from real users](#how-fast-is-it). - **Close to the original:** Maya's own quants of GLM-5.3-Flash keep 97.7-99.2% of the FP8 model's zero-shot accuracy; DeepSeek V4.1 · Maya-S picks the same next token as the original 92.6% of the time, MiniMax M3.1 · Maya-S 87.6% (the average over its categories). - **Plugs into your tools:** OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API with tool calls, ready for coding agents. - **Several requests at once:** up to 8 answered together with GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash - for agents that run several sessions, or several people on one PC. - **Everything in the box:** a chat and a live monitor in the browser, pictures, thinking levels, a one-command setup. ## Quick start ```sh git clone https://github.com/mw00/project-maya.git && cd project-maya ./setup.sh ``` The setup asks which model you want, downloads it, builds everything once and **starts the model**. Then open `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Windows: `START-MAYA.bat` instead of `./setup.sh`. More in [Install](#install). ## Pick your model Every Maya quant is named after its model, then its tier - XS, S, M or L, by how many bits its experts keep. The setup recommends one for your PC; to pick one yourself, give its setup id: `./setup.sh --model glm-maya-s24`. | Model | Maya quant · setup id | Size | Made for | | --- | --- | ---: | --- | | **[GLM-5.3-Flash](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash)**
zai-org · MIT · 321 B, 18 B active · up to 1M context | **Maya-S** (default) · `glm-maya-s` | 96.5 GB | PCs with a smaller memory pool (RAM and VRAM together) | | | Maya-S24 · `glm-maya-s24` | 94.7 GB | cards of 24 GB or less: ~1.5 GB more of the card for experts, decode +14% | | | Maya-M · `glm-maya-m` | 116 GB | a bigger memory pool; calibrated toward tool calls and front-end code | | | Maya-M-Derisked · `glm-maya-m-derisked` | 116 GB | Maya-M with a weight edit by [Blackfrost_AI](https://x.com/Blackfrost_AI) that reduces blanket refusals; experimental | | | Maya-L · `glm-maya-l` | 156.3 GB | the biggest memory pools; the closest to the original | | **[DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017)**
DeepSeek · MIT · 748 B | **Maya-S** (default) · `deepseek-maya-s` | 340 GB | any amount of memory: what VRAM and RAM don't hold is read from the SSD | | | Maya-XS · `deepseek-maya-xs` | 277 GB | the whole model in a 128 GB PC's memory (the Engram tables stay on the SSD) | | **[MiniMax-M3.1-Flash](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash)**
MiniMax · [MiniMax Community License](LICENSE.minimax-m31) · 428 B, 23 B active · up to 1M context | Maya-XS · `minimax-maya-xs` | 93 GB | the whole model in a 128 GB PC's memory | | | Maya-S · `minimax-maya-s` | 122 GB | closer to the original | All of them run on NVIDIA from the V100 / RTX 20 on, and on AMD and W CENTRO: CEDRO-8361 indows (experimental; see [What you need](#what-you-need)). DeepSeek's sizes include its Engram tables. The setup also offers unsloth's GGUF and LibertAIDAI's EXL3 quants of DeepSeek, orcarouter's abliterated DeepSeek, Mia-AiLab's EXL3 quant of MiniMax, turboderp's EXL3 quants of GLM, and Qwen-3.8-Flash-Next (CYBER-FROST) as its Q5_K_M GGUF, with pictures ([its settings](docs/SETTINGS.md#qwen-38-flash-next-cyber-frost)). **Each model's files, drafters, pictures and options: [docs/MODELS.md](docs/MODELS.md).** ## Quality Maya's quants are made from each model's released weights and measured against the original: - **GLM-5.3 · Maya quants** keep 97.7-99.2% of the FP8 model's zero-shot accuracy and pick its next token 83-90% of the time (Maya-L: 99.2%, 90%). How they're made and measured: [MAYA-S](bench/results/MAYA-S.md), [MAYA-S24](bench/results/MAYA-S24.md), [MAYA-M](bench/results/MAYA-M.md), [MAYA-L](bench/results/MAYA-L.md). - **DeepSeek V4.1 · Maya-S** picks the same next token as the original 92.6% of the time. - **MiniMax M3.1 · Maya-S** picks it 87.6% of the time (the average over its categories). More on each model's card on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/peasantsmith). ## How fast is it? Real machines measured by our users, most with `./maya.sh --bench` (decode: three greedy 256-token answers; prefill: an 8K-token prompt unless the row says otherwise). Share yours: `--bench`, then `--report`, in a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/issues).
